title: Don't pass fetched data up from a child Effect

slides.say: A child fetches data, then hands it to the parent from an Effect. It works, but it breaks React’s data flow.
When children update their parent’s state from Effects, it is very hard to trace where wrong data came from.
Both need the data, so let the parent fetch it and pass it down. Data flows from parent to child.

slides.text: Down is predictable: follow the props up to find the source.
slides.say: When data flows down, you can always trace a bug by walking up the component chain.
